subject: Web Development
title: Douglas Crockford and the Good Parts
description: A 60-second lesson on Douglas Crockford and the Good Parts.

hook.text: In 2008, Douglas Crockford published a thin book that changed how people saw JavaScript.

buildup.text: 'JavaScript: The Good Parts' argued the language had a beautiful core hidden under bad design.

discovery.text: Crockford showed that closures, first-class functions, and prototypes were genuinely powerful.

twist.text: The book was famous for being thin. Most JavaScript features were in the 'bad parts.'

climax.text: Crockford also created JSON, the data format that replaced XML across the entire web.

punchline.text: One thin book redeemed an entire language.

quiz.question: What data format did Douglas Crockford create?
